name: git_ops
description: Execute a git operation on a repository. Supports: fetch, rebase, merge, pull, checkout, worktree_add, worktree_remove, worktree_list, worktree_prune. Use for syncing branches, switching branches, and managing worktrees. NOT for committing or creating PRs.

operation.description: The git operation to perform: 'fetch' downloads remote refs, 'rebase' replays commits onto a base (auto-aborts on conflict), 'merge' fast-forwards to a base, 'pull' fetches and fast-forward merges in one call, 'checkout' switches to a branch, 'worktree_add' creates a worktree, 'worktree_remove' removes a worktree, 'worktree_list' lists worktrees, 'worktree_prune' cleans up stale worktrees

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the git repository directory

base.description: Remote ref to target (e.g. 'origin/main', 'upstream/develop'). Used by fetch, rebase, merge, pull, and worktree_add. Default: 'origin/main'

push.description: Force-push with lease after a successful rebase. Only allowed with 'rebase' operation. Default: false

branch.description: Branch name. Required for 'checkout' (branch to switch to) and 'worktree_add' (branch to create or attach). For checkout, auto-creates a tracking branch if it exists on the remote.

path.description: Absolute filesystem path. Required for 'worktree_add' (where to create the worktree) and 'worktree_remove' (which worktree to remove).
